name: 23834 · Colonial Hgts, VA
findings: ZIP 23834 (Colonial Hgts) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23834 (Colonial Hgts) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 23834 (Colonial Hgts) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).
